document.abstract: The application of a stereo viewing periscope to a type SFR (CΦP) rotating-mirror framing camera permits the recording of a sequence of full frame stereo pairs at rates up to 1,250,000 pairs/sec. Because of the simultaneous recording of the stereo pairs, accurate quantitative space-time relations of events can be obtained in three-dimension with the aid of a stereometer. Stereo cine projection is also possible. Studies have been made of the initial stages of the detonation of explosives.
